async def act(page):
    # Use the searchbox to filter for 'gimmiethat.space'
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name')
    await searchbox.fill('gimmiethat.space')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for filtering to take effect
    
    # Check if the project link appears in the filtered list
    # Based on the tree, project links are under headings with names like 'Byte Blaze / project-name'
    # Look for a link with name containing 'gimmiethat.space'
    project_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='gimmiethat.space', exact=False)
    if await project_link.count() > 0:
        await project_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    else:
        # If not found, the project might not exist or be accessible
        return 'Project not found or no access.'
    
    # Now on the project details page, navigate to Settings -> Members
    # First, find the Settings link
    settings_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Settings', exact=False)
    await settings_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Then, find the Members link within settings
    members_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Members', exact=False)
    await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Extract usernames from the members page
    # Usernames are likely in links or list items; use get_by_role to find all relevant elements
    # First, try to get all links on the page
    username_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    count = await username_links.count()
    usernames = []
    for i in range(count):
        link = username_links.nth(i)
        text = await link.text_content()
        if text and text.strip():
            usernames.append(text.strip())
    
    # If no links found, try other roles like 'listitem' if present
    if not usernames:
        listitems = page.get_by_role('listitem')
        li_count = await listitems.count()
        for i in range(li_count):
            item = listitems.nth(i)
            text = await item.text_content()
            if text and text.strip():
                usernames.append(text.strip())
    
    # Return the usernames as a newline-separated string
    result = '\n'.join(usernames)
    return result
